WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded') AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded')
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    behavior_count,
    behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    behavior_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  order_type_mix,
  behavior_count,
  share,
  share - baseline_average_share AS above_baseline_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > baseline_average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing order type mix is represented by the label 'No mix recorded'; shares and the baseline are calculated over matched behaviour records and the distinct mix groups, with each group weighted equally in the baseline.
